text: {"status":"answered","answer":"You need to keep a minimum daily balance of $100 in your Primary Share Account to earn dividends, under the Savings Account Terms and Conditions (version DEP-TC-003). On any day the balance falls below $100, no dividends are earned for that day. The Q3 2026 Deposit Rate Sheet shows the Primary Share Savings rate at $100 and above as 0.10% dividend rate / 0.10% APY (variable).","cited_chunk_ids":["savings_terms::layout::B_structure::0001","deposit_rate_sheet_2026q3::layout::B_structure::0001"],"reason":"The savings terms state the $100 minimum daily balance requirement directly, and the rate sheet confirms the matching balance tier."}
